sentences.zh: 志七十二

translations.literal: Treatise Seventy-Two
translations.idiomatic: Treatise Seventy-Two

sentences.zh: 樂四

translations.literal: Music Four
translations.idiomatic: Music, Part Four

sentences.zh: 皇帝元旦御殿二章康熙八年定，乾隆七年重撰樂章。

translations.literal: Two sections for the Emperor's New Year's Day audience at the imperial hall were established in the eighth year of Kangxi; the music texts were revised in the seventh year of Qianlong.
translations.idiomatic: Two musical sections for the emperor's New Year's Day audience at the imperial hall were established in Kangxi 8, and their texts were revised in Qianlong 7.

sentences.zh: 初制附載。

translations.literal: The original versions are appended.
translations.idiomatic: The original compositions are appended below.

sentences.zh: 中和韶樂，黃鍾宮立宮，倍夷則下羽主調。

translations.literal: Zhonghe Shaoyue: Huangzhong mode as the establishment mode, with doubled Yize lower Yu as the main mode.
translations.idiomatic: For Zhonghe Shaoyue, Huangzhong serves as the establishment mode and doubled Yize lower Yu as the primary mode.

sentences.zh: 升座元平維天眷我皇，四海昇平泰運昌。

translations.literal: Ascending the throne—Yuanping: Heaven favors our emperor; the four seas rise in peace and great fortune flourishes.
translations.idiomatic: Ascending the throne (Yuanping): Heaven blesses our emperor; peace reigns across the four seas and great fortune abounds.

sentences.zh: 歲首肇三陽，萬國朝正拜帝閶。

translations.literal: At the year's beginning the three yang commence; the myriad states pay New Year's homage at the imperial gate.
translations.idiomatic: At the year's dawn the three yang arise; all nations come to offer New Year's homage at the imperial gate.

sentences.zh: 雲物奏嘉祥，乘鸞輅，建太常。

translations.literal: Cloud omens report auspicious signs; riding the phoenix carriage, raising the Grand Standard.
translations.idiomatic: Auspicious signs appear in the heavens; the emperor mounts the imperial carriage and displays the Grand Standard.

sentences.zh: 時和化日長，重九譯，盡梯航。

translations.literal: Seasons harmonize and transforming days lengthen; tribute from distant nine regions, all come by ladder-ships.
translations.idiomatic: Seasons harmonize and the days of transformation grow long; distant lands across the nine regions arrive by every route of land and sea.

sentences.zh: 原於穆元後，敬授人時。

translations.literal: Original: Reverently the primordial sovereign bestows the seasons upon the people.
translations.idiomatic: Original version: The august sovereign reverently grants humankind the calendar.

sentences.zh: 四始和令，三陽肇基。

translations.literal: The four beginnings harmonize with the ordinances; the three yang lay the foundation.
translations.idiomatic: The four beginnings accord with the ordinances, and the three yang establish the year's foundation.

sentences.zh: 鸞路蒼龍，載青其旂。

translations.literal: The phoenix road with azure dragon; bearing green banners.
translations.idiomatic: Along the imperial way the azure dragon goes, bearing green banners aloft.

sentences.zh: 迎氣布德，百工允釐。

translations.literal: Welcoming the qi and spreading virtue; the hundred offices truly are regulated.
translations.idiomatic: Welcoming the seasonal qi and spreading virtue, the hundred offices are duly ordered.

sentences.zh: 行慶施惠，及我烝黎。

translations.literal: Bestowing celebration and extending grace, reaching our multitudes.
translations.idiomatic: Bestowing celebration and extending grace to all our people.

sentences.zh: 還宮和平聖人延俊英，鈞天樂奏繞彤廷。

translations.literal: Returning to the palace—Heping: The sage extends invitation to worthy talents; music of the Azure Heaven plays around the vermilion court.
translations.idiomatic: Returning to the palace (Heping): The sage gathers worthy talents; celestial music resounds throughout the vermilion hall.

sentences.zh: 華夷一統寧，士庶歡忻樂太平。

translations.literal: Chinese and barbarian unified in peace; scholars and commoners rejoice in great peace.
translations.idiomatic: Chinese and foreign peoples are united in peace; scholars and commoners alike rejoice in an age of tranquility.

sentences.zh: 寶鼎御香盈，祥煙裊，瑞靄生。

translations.literal: Precious censers filled with imperial incense; auspicious smoke curls, propitious mist arises.
translations.idiomatic: Precious censers brim with imperial incense; auspicious smoke curls upward and propitious mist rises.

sentences.zh: 簫韶喜九成，齊慶祝，萬千齡。

translations.literal: The Xiaoshao delights in the ninefold completion; all together celebrate, for ten thousand thousand years.
translations.idiomatic: The music of Xiaoshao celebrates its perfect ninefold form; all join in wishing ten thousand ages of blessing.

sentences.zh: 原有奕元會，天子穆穆。

translations.literal: Original: Majestic is the New Year's assembly; the Son of Heaven is dignified.
translations.idiomatic: Original version: Grand is the New Year's assembly; the Son of Heaven sits in solemn dignity.

sentences.zh: 鏘鏘群公，至自九服。

translations.literal: Resounding are the assembled lords, arriving from the nine domains.
translations.idiomatic: The assembled lords arrive in solemn procession from the nine domains.

sentences.zh: 正朔所加，海外臣僕。

translations.literal: Where the calendar reaches, overseas subjects and servants.
translations.idiomatic: Wherever the imperial calendar extends, overseas peoples become subjects and servants.

sentences.zh: 率土懷惠，萬民子育。

translations.literal: All within the realm cherish his grace; the myriad people he nurtures as children.
translations.idiomatic: All within the realm cherish his grace; he nurtures the myriad people as his own children.

sentences.zh: 千齡億祀，永綏茀祿。

translations.literal: For a thousand ages and ten thousand sacrifices, forever securing abundant blessings.
translations.idiomatic: For a thousand ages and ten thousand years, may abundant blessings endure forever.

sentences.zh: 皇帝長至御殿二章康熙八年定，乾隆七年重撰樂章。

translations.literal: Two sections for the Emperor's Winter Solstice audience at the imperial hall were established in the eighth year of Kangxi; the music texts were revised in the seventh year of Qianlong.
translations.idiomatic: Two musical sections for the emperor's Winter Solstice audience at the imperial hall were established in Kangxi 8, and their texts were revised in Qianlong 7.

sentences.zh: 初制附載。

translations.literal: The original versions are appended.
translations.idiomatic: The original compositions are appended below.

sentences.zh: 中和韶樂，黃鍾宮立宮，倍夷則下羽主調。

translations.literal: Zhonghe Shaoyue: Huangzhong mode as the establishment mode, with doubled Yize lower Yu as the main mode.
translations.idiomatic: For Zhonghe Shaoyue, Huangzhong serves as the establishment mode and doubled Yize lower Yu as the primary mode.

sentences.zh: 升座遂平陽回黍谷春，萬國衣冠拜紫宸。

translations.literal: Ascending the throne—Suiping: The yang returns to the Millet Valley in spring; the myriad states in court dress bow before the Purple Forbidden Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Ascending the throne (Suiping): Spring returns to the Millet Valley; envoys from all nations in court dress bow before the Purple Forbidden Hall.

sentences.zh: 旭日耀龍鱗，雲物呈祥福祿臻。

translations.literal: The rising sun gleams on dragon scales; cloud omens display auspicious signs and fortune and emolument arrive.
translations.idiomatic: The rising sun gleams upon the dragon's scales; auspicious signs appear in the heavens and fortune and blessing arrive.

sentences.zh: 堯階蓂莢新，熙庶績，撫五辰。

translations.literal: On Yao's steps the mingling plant sprouts anew; flourishing the myriad achievements, governing the five seasons.
translations.idiomatic: On Yao's steps the mingling plant sprouts anew; he flourishes the myriad achievements and governs the five seasons.

sentences.zh: 九服共來賓，調元化，轉鴻鈞。

translations.literal: The nine domains all come as guests; harmonizing the primal transformation, turning the great balance.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys from the nine domains all come as guests; he harmonizes the primal transformation and turns the great cosmic balance.

sentences.zh: 原乾符在握，道轉鴻鈞。

translations.literal: Original: The mandate of Heaven is grasped in hand; the Way turns the great balance.
translations.idiomatic: Original version: The mandate of Heaven is held firmly in hand; the Way turns the great cosmic balance.

sentences.zh: 天心見復，物始資元。

translations.literal: Heaven's heart shows return; things begin to receive the primal.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's heart reveals the return of yang; all things begin to receive the primal source.

sentences.zh: 景長舜日，紀協堯春。

translations.literal: The days lengthen like Shun's sun; the calendar accords with Yao's spring.
translations.idiomatic: The days lengthen as in the age of Shun; the calendar accords with the spring of Yao.

sentences.zh: 玉琯應瑞，寶曆肇新。

translations.literal: The jade pitch-pipe responds with auspicious signs; the precious calendar begins anew.
translations.idiomatic: The jade pitch-pipe responds with auspicious signs; the precious calendar begins anew.

sentences.zh: 眾正在位，輔翼一人。

translations.literal: The multitude of worthies are in their places, assisting and supporting the One Man.
translations.idiomatic: The multitude of worthies take their places, assisting and supporting the sovereign.

sentences.zh: 還宮允平皇心克配天，玉琯葭灰得氣先。

translations.literal: Returning to the palace—Yunping: The imperial heart can match Heaven; the jade pitch-pipe and reed ash receive the qi first.
translations.idiomatic: Returning to the palace (Yunping): The emperor's heart matches Heaven; the jade pitch-pipe and reed ash receive the seasonal qi first.

sentences.zh: 彤廷臚唱宣，四海共球奏御筵。

translations.literal: At the vermilion court the ceremonial announcement is proclaimed; the four seas present tribute at the imperial banquet.
translations.idiomatic: At the vermilion court the ceremonial announcement resounds; tribute from the four seas is presented at the imperial banquet.

sentences.zh: 珠斗應璣璿，金鏡朗，麟鳳騫。

translations.literal: Pearl and Dipper respond to the jade scepter-stars; the golden mirror is bright, unicorn and phoenix soar.
translations.idiomatic: Pearl and Dipper respond to the jade stars; the golden mirror shines bright, and unicorn and phoenix soar aloft.

sentences.zh: 人間景福全，咨屢省，懋乾乾。

translations.literal: Among humankind blessings are complete; repeatedly examining and reflecting, diligently striving.
translations.idiomatic: Blessings for humankind are complete; he repeatedly examines himself and strives with unceasing diligence.

sentences.zh: 原萬國在宥，一陽斯溥。

translations.literal: Original: The myriad states are under his nurturing care; the one yang is broadly spread.
translations.idiomatic: Original version: The myriad states rest under his nurturing care; the one yang spreads broadly.

sentences.zh: 淵默臨朝，天職修舉。

translations.literal: Deep and silent in holding court; Heaven's duties are properly performed.
translations.idiomatic: Deep and silent he holds court; Heaven's duties are duly fulfilled.

sentences.zh: 君子道長，駢珪聯組。

translations.literal: The way of the noble man grows long; jade tablets and ribbons are paired and linked.
translations.idiomatic: The way of the noble man grows ever longer; jade tablets and official ribbons fill the court in ranks.

sentences.zh: 瞻日書雲，產祥降嘏。

translations.literal: Observing the sun and inscribing the clouds; producing auspicious signs and sending down blessings.
translations.idiomatic: He observes the sun and inscribes the clouds; auspicious signs appear and blessings descend.

sentences.zh: 宜暘而暘，宜雨而雨。

translations.literal: When sunshine is fitting, there is sunshine; when rain is fitting, there is rain.
translations.idiomatic: When sunshine is needed, sunshine comes; when rain is needed, rain falls.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十四年，平定回部，長至御殿，增撰武成慶語二章中和韶樂，黃鍾宮立宮，倍夷則下羽主調。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year of Qianlong, upon the pacification of the Muslim regions, for the Winter Solstice audience at the imperial hall, two additional sections of martial victory celebration texts were composed for Zhonghe Shaoyue, with Huangzhong mode as the establishment mode and doubled Yize lower Yu as the main mode.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 24, upon the pacification of the Muslim regions, two additional martial victory celebration sections were composed for the Winter Solstice audience at the imperial hall, using Zhonghe Shaoyue with Huangzhong as the establishment mode and doubled Yize lower Yu as the primary mode.

sentences.zh: 升座遂平陽回玉琯春，華闕晴暉映紫宸。

translations.literal: Ascending the throne—Suiping: The yang returns to the jade pitch-pipe in spring; the splendid gate in clear sunlight reflects upon the Purple Forbidden Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Ascending the throne (Suiping): Spring returns to the jade pitch-pipe; the splendid gate gleams in clear sunlight upon the Purple Forbidden Hall.

sentences.zh: 聲教訖無垠，烽燧長清玉塞塵。

translations.literal: Civilizing instruction reaches without limit; beacon fires long cleared, jade frontier passes free of dust.
translations.idiomatic: Civilizing instruction reaches without limit; beacon fires stay extinguished and the jade frontier passes are free of war's dust.

sentences.zh: 絕域盡王臣，安作息，荷陶甄。

translations.literal: The farthest regions all become royal subjects; resting and rising in peace, receiving molding and nurture.
translations.idiomatic: The farthest regions all become royal subjects; they live in peace, nurtured by imperial care.

sentences.zh: 奉贄獻靈珍。

translations.literal: Presenting tribute and offering spiritual treasures.
translations.idiomatic: They present tribute and offer precious treasures.

sentences.zh: 超三古，懋經綸。

translations.literal: Surpassing the three antiquities; vigorously governing state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Surpassing the three antiquities, he vigorously governs the realm.

sentences.zh: 還宮允平淑氣轉瑤閶，緹幕葭飛啟百昌。

translations.literal: Returning to the palace—Yunping: Pure qi turns at the jade gate; reed ash flies in the crimson curtain, opening the hundred prosperities.
translations.idiomatic: Returning to the palace (Yunping): Pure qi turns at the jade gate; reed ash flies in the crimson curtain, ushering in the hundred prosperities.

sentences.zh: 恩威亙八荒，雪嶺天山道里長。

translations.literal: Grace and majesty extend across the eight wilds; from Snow Ridge to Heaven Mountain the roads are long.
translations.idiomatic: Grace and majesty extend across the eight wilds; from Snow Ridge to Heaven Mountain the roads stretch far.

sentences.zh: 納款鄉明堂，三足鳥，暨鳳凰。

translations.literal: Submitting allegiance at the Bright Hall; the three-legged bird, and the phoenix.
translations.idiomatic: They submit allegiance at the Bright Hall; the three-legged bird and the phoenix appear as omens.

sentences.zh: 乾珍普降祥，彌顧禔，敕幾康。

translations.literal: Heaven's treasures broadly send down auspicious signs; ever mindful of blessing, commanding diligence in governance.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's treasures broadly send down auspicious signs; ever mindful of blessing, he commands diligence in governance.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十四年，平定回部御殿，群臣慶賀一章丹陛大樂

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year of Qianlong, upon the pacification of the Muslim regions, audience at the imperial hall, one section of celebration by the assembled ministers—Danbi Dayue.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 24, upon the pacification of the Muslim regions, one celebration section by the assembled ministers at the imperial hall audience, using Danbi Dayue.

sentences.zh: 慶平紫霧氤氳浮彩仗，丹階虎隊鵷行。

translations.literal: Qingping: Purple mist dense and floating over colored halberds; on the vermilion steps tiger guards and egret ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Qingping: Purple mist dense and floating over colored halberds; on the vermilion steps tiger guards and egret ranks stand in formation.

sentences.zh: 敷文德，虞徽接響。

translations.literal: Spreading civil virtue; the music of Yu echoes in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Spreading civil virtue; the music of Yu echoes in succession.

sentences.zh: 靖邊徼，來享來王。

translations.literal: Pacifying the frontier passes; coming to enjoy and coming to serve as king.
translations.idiomatic: Pacifying the frontier passes; they come to pay homage and submit as vassals.

sentences.zh: 皇帝萬壽節御殿二章康熙八年定，乾隆七年重撰樂章。

translations.literal: Two sections for the Emperor's Longevity Festival audience at the imperial hall were established in the eighth year of Kangxi; the music texts were revised in the seventh year of Qianlong.
translations.idiomatic: Two musical sections for the emperor's Longevity Festival audience at the imperial hall were established in Kangxi 8, and their texts were revised in Qianlong 7.

sentences.zh: 初制附載。

translations.literal: The original versions are appended.
translations.idiomatic: The original compositions are appended below.

sentences.zh: 中和韶樂，黃鍾宮立宮，倍夷則下羽主調。

translations.literal: Zhonghe Shaoyue: Huangzhong mode as the establishment mode, with doubled Yize lower Yu as the main mode.
translations.idiomatic: For Zhonghe Shaoyue, Huangzhong serves as the establishment mode and doubled Yize lower Yu as the primary mode.

sentences.zh: 升座乾平祥雲扈紫冥，四海臣民祝聖齡。

translations.literal: Ascending the throne—Qianping: Auspicious clouds escort the purple heavens; the four seas' subjects and people bless the sage's years.
translations.idiomatic: Ascending the throne (Qianping): Auspicious clouds escort the purple heavens; subjects and people across the four seas bless the sage's years.

sentences.zh: 淑氣轉階蓂，堯籙羲圖燦御屏。

translations.literal: Pure qi turns on the mingling steps; Yao's tally and Fuxi's chart shine on the imperial screen.
translations.idiomatic: Pure qi turns on the mingling steps; Yao's tally and Fuxi's chart gleam upon the imperial screen.

sentences.zh: 嵩呼遍在廷，天呈瑞，地效靈。

translations.literal: Mount Song acclamations fill the court; Heaven displays auspicious signs, Earth manifests spiritual response.
translations.idiomatic: Acclamations like those for Mount Song fill the court; Heaven displays auspicious signs and Earth manifests spiritual response.

sentences.zh: 南極拱台星，億萬載，頌康寧。

translations.literal: The South Pole arches toward the Terrace Star; for ten thousand myriad years, praising peace and tranquility.
translations.idiomatic: The South Pole arches toward the Terrace Star; for ten thousand myriad years they praise peace and tranquility.

sentences.zh: 原二儀清寧，三辰順則。

translations.literal: Original: The two principles are clear and tranquil; the three luminaries follow their ordinances.
translations.idiomatic: Original version: The two principles are clear and tranquil; the three luminaries follow their proper courses.

sentences.zh: 維帝凝命，函冒區域。

translations.literal: The Emperor consolidates the mandate, enveloping the realm.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor consolidates the mandate, enveloping the entire realm.

sentences.zh: 仁恩廣覃，至於動植。

translations.literal: Benevolent grace broadly extends, reaching even to moving and rooted beings.
translations.idiomatic: Benevolent grace extends broadly, reaching even to all living and rooted things.

sentences.zh: 久道化成，隆功駿德。

translations.literal: Long has the Way transformed into culture; lofty achievements and eminent virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Long has the Way transformed into culture; his achievements are lofty and his virtue eminent.

sentences.zh: 聖人多壽，年世萬億。

translations.literal: The sage has many years of life; his years number ten thousand myriad.
translations.idiomatic: The sage enjoys long life; may his years number ten thousand myriad.

sentences.zh: 還宮泰平皇躬福祿宜，永紹鴻圖丕丕基。

translations.literal: Returning to the palace—Taiping: The imperial person is fit for fortune and emolument; forever continuing the great design and vast foundation.
translations.idiomatic: Returning to the palace (Taiping): Fortune and emolument befit the imperial person; may he forever continue the great design and vast foundation.

sentences.zh: 彤陛長仙芝，樂奏簫韶丹鳳儀。

translations.literal: On the vermilion steps grows immortal fungus; music plays Xiaoshao and the vermilion phoenix displays its grace.
translations.idiomatic: Immortal fungus grows on the vermilion steps; Xiaoshao is played and the vermilion phoenix displays its grace.

sentences.zh: 南山獻壽卮，人心悅，天意隨。

translations.literal: The Southern Mountain presents the longevity cup; people's hearts rejoice, Heaven's intent follows.
translations.idiomatic: The Southern Mountain presents the cup of longevity; people's hearts rejoice and Heaven's intent accords.

sentences.zh: 為德遍群黎，歌樂愷，萬年斯。

translations.literal: His virtue reaches all the multitudes; songs and music are harmonious, for ten thousand years thus.
translations.idiomatic: His virtue reaches all the people; songs and music are harmonious, for ten thousand years to come.

sentences.zh: 原鑒觀惟德，丕命惟皇。

translations.literal: Original: Heaven observes only virtue; the great mandate belongs to the Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Original version: Heaven observes only virtue; the great mandate belongs to the Emperor.

sentences.zh: 肇茲壽域，薄海要荒。

translations.literal: Beginning this realm of longevity, reaching to the sea's edge and the farthest wilds.
translations.idiomatic: Beginning this realm of longevity, reaching to the sea's edge and the farthest wilds.

sentences.zh: 物性茂育，民俗樂康。

translations.literal: The nature of things flourishes in growth; folk customs are joyful and at peace.
translations.idiomatic: All things flourish in growth; folk customs are joyful and at peace.

sentences.zh: 冠帶之國，望斗辨方。

translations.literal: States of cap and girdle, gazing at the Dipper to distinguish directions.
translations.idiomatic: States of cap and girdle gaze at the Dipper to know their place.

sentences.zh: 曰惟萬年，同於昊蒼。

translations.literal: It is said to be ten thousand years, the same as the vast azure Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: May it endure ten thousand years, equal to the vast azure Heaven.

sentences.zh: 萬壽、元旦、長至三大節朝賀三章常朝同。

translations.literal: Three sections for court congratulations on the three great festivals of Longevity, New Year's Day, and Winter Solstice, the same as for regular court audiences.
translations.idiomatic: Three sections for court congratulations on the three great festivals—Longevity, New Year's Day, and Winter Solstice—the same as for regular court audiences.

sentences.zh: 順治九年定，康熙年制樂章，乾隆七年重撰。

translations.literal: Established in the ninth year of Shunzhi; music texts composed in the Kangxi reign, revised in the seventh year of Qianlong.
translations.idiomatic: Established in Shunzhi 9; music texts were composed in the Kangxi reign and revised in Qianlong 7.

sentences.zh: 又增宮中行禮雝平一章。

translations.literal: Also added one section, Yongping, for ceremonies within the palace.
translations.idiomatic: One additional section, Yongping, was added for ceremonies within the palace.

sentences.zh: 初制附載。

translations.literal: The original versions are appended.
translations.idiomatic: The original compositions are appended below.

sentences.zh: 丹陛大樂

translations.literal: Danbi Dayue
translations.idiomatic: Danbi Dayue (Great Music on the Vermilion Steps)

sentences.zh: 群臣行禮慶平鳳凰在藪，麒麟在郊坰。

translations.literal: Assembled ministers perform rites—Qingping: The phoenix is in the marsh, the unicorn in the suburban wilds.
translations.idiomatic: Assembled ministers perform rites (Qingping): The phoenix dwells in the marsh and the unicorn in the suburban wilds.

sentences.zh: 不如國士充陛廷，野無遺賢宗有英。

translations.literal: How could it compare to having worthy men fill the court steps; in the wilds none are overlooked, the clan has outstanding men.
translations.idiomatic: Better still are worthy men filling the court steps; no talent is overlooked in the wilds, and the imperial house has outstanding men.

sentences.zh: 夙夜在公，在公明明。

translations.literal: Early and late in service to the lord; in service to the lord, bright and clear.
translations.idiomatic: Early and late in service to the lord; in service to the lord, bright and clear.

sentences.zh: 原皇覆萬宇，品物咸亨。

translations.literal: Original: The Emperor covers the myriad realms; all things flourish in prosperity.
translations.idiomatic: Original version: The Emperor covers the myriad realms; all things flourish in prosperity.

sentences.zh: 九賓在列，百譯輸誠。

translations.literal: The nine guests are in their ranks; the hundred interpreters convey sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: The nine guests stand in their ranks; envoys from a hundred lands convey their sincerity.

sentences.zh: 濟濟卿士，式造在廷。

translations.literal: Abundant are the ministers and scholars; they come to the court in ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: Abundant are the ministers and scholars; they come to the court in solemn ceremony.

sentences.zh: 帝仁如天，帝明如日。

translations.literal: The Emperor's benevolence is like Heaven; the Emperor's brilliance is like the sun.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor's benevolence is like Heaven; the Emperor's brilliance is like the sun.

sentences.zh: 親賢任能，愛民育物。

translations.literal: Drawing close to the worthy and employing the capable; loving the people and nurturing things.
translations.idiomatic: He draws close to the worthy and employs the capable; he loves the people and nurtures all things.

sentences.zh: 禮備樂成，聲教四訖。

translations.literal: Rites are complete and music is accomplished; civilizing instruction reaches the four quarters.
translations.idiomatic: Rites are complete and music is accomplished; civilizing instruction reaches the four quarters.

sentences.zh: 外籓行禮治平我清世德，作求若天行。

translations.literal: Outer vassals perform rites—Zhiping: Our Qing dynasty's world virtue, sought as Heaven's conduct.
translations.idiomatic: Outer vassals perform rites (Zhiping): Our Qing dynasty's world virtue is sought as Heaven's own conduct.

sentences.zh: 天盡所覆畀我清，萬方悅喜來享庭。

translations.literal: Heaven all that it covers bestows upon our Qing; the myriad regions in joy come to enjoy at the court.
translations.idiomatic: All that Heaven covers is bestowed upon our Qing; the myriad regions come in joy to pay homage at the court.

sentences.zh: 曰予一人，業業兢兢。

translations.literal: Thus I, the One Man, am fearful and cautious.
translations.idiomatic: Thus I, the One Man, am ever fearful and cautious.

sentences.zh: 原天盡所覆，以畀我清。

translations.literal: Original: Heaven all that it covers, to bestow upon our Qing.
translations.idiomatic: Original version: All that Heaven covers is bestowed upon our Qing.

sentences.zh: 我德配命，涵濡群生。

translations.literal: Our virtue matches the mandate, moistening and nurturing the multitude of living beings.
translations.idiomatic: Our virtue matches the mandate, nourishing and sustaining all living beings.

sentences.zh: 萬國蹈舞，來享來庭。

translations.literal: The myriad states dance in step; coming to enjoy, coming to the court.
translations.idiomatic: The myriad states dance in step; they come to pay homage at the court.

sentences.zh: 俁俁蹲蹲，視彼干戚。

translations.literal: Grand and stately, squatting and rising, gazing at those shields and axes.
translations.idiomatic: Grand and stately they squat and rise, gazing upon the shields and battle-axes.

sentences.zh: 天威式臨，其儀不忒。

translations.literal: Heaven's majesty is solemnly present; its rites are without error.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's majesty is solemnly present; its rites are performed without error.

sentences.zh: 宮中行禮雝平關雎四教，家邦作孚先。

translations.literal: Palace ceremony—Yongping: The Guanju's four teachings; first establishing trust in family and state.
translations.idiomatic: Palace ceremony, Yongping: The four teachings of the Guanju, first establishing trust in family and state.

sentences.zh: 黃裳元吉地承天，六宮仁順化穆宣。

translations.literal: Yellow lower garment, primordially auspicious; Earth receives Heaven; the six palaces in benevolence and compliance spread gentle instruction.
translations.idiomatic: The yellow lower garment is primordially auspicious; Earth receives Heaven; the six palaces spread gentle instruction through benevolence and compliance.

sentences.zh: 麟之趾兮，萬福之原。

translations.literal: The unicorn's hooves—ah, the source of ten thousand blessings.
translations.idiomatic: The unicorn's hooves are the source of ten thousand blessings.

sentences.zh: 皇帝上元御殿二章乾隆七年定。

translations.literal: Two sections for the Emperor's Shangyuan Festival audience at the imperial hall, established in the seventh year of Qianlong.
translations.idiomatic: Two musical sections for the emperor's Shangyuan Festival audience at the imperial hall were established in Qianlong 7.

sentences.zh: 中和韶樂，太簇商立宮，倍無射變宮主調。

translations.literal: Zhonghe Shaoyue: Taicu Shang mode as the establishment mode, with doubled Wushe bian mode as the main mode.
translations.idiomatic: For Zhonghe Shaoyue, Taicu Shang serves as the establishment mode and doubled Wushe bian mode as the primary mode.

sentences.zh: 升座怡平皇心保泰和，海昇平樂事多。

translations.literal: Ascending the throne—Yiping: The imperial heart preserves great peace and harmony; the seas rise in peace and joyful affairs are many.
translations.idiomatic: Ascending the throne, Yiping: The imperial heart preserves great peace and harmony; the seas are tranquil and joyful affairs abound.

sentences.zh: 瓊樹長新柯，冰泮春風漲玉河。

translations.literal: The jade tree grows new branches; ice melts and spring wind swells the jade river.
translations.idiomatic: The jade tree puts forth new branches; ice melts and spring winds swell the jade river.

sentences.zh: 晴雲展細羅，擎堯酒，泛天波。

translations.literal: Clear clouds spread fine gauze; raising Yao's wine, floating on Heaven's waves.
translations.idiomatic: Clear clouds spread like fine gauze; they raise Yao's wine and float upon Heaven's waves.

sentences.zh: 花舞鳥能歌，齊拜手，賦卷阿。

translations.literal: Flowers dance and birds can sing; all together bow with hands joined, composing verses of Juan'a.
translations.idiomatic: Flowers dance and birds sing; all bow with joined hands and compose verses of Juan'a.

sentences.zh: 還宮昇平時雍頌帝堯，玉佩鏗鏘慶早朝。

translations.literal: Returning to the palace—Shengping: In harmonious times praising Emperor Yao; jade pendants ring in celebration of the early court.
translations.idiomatic: Returning to the palace, Shengping: In harmonious times they praise Emperor Yao; jade pendants ring in celebration of the early court.

sentences.zh: 紫禁瑞煙飄，春意凌寒上柳條。

translations.literal: In the Forbidden City auspicious smoke drifts; spring intent rises above the cold upon willow branches.
translations.idiomatic: In the Forbidden City auspicious smoke drifts; spring's intent rises above the cold upon the willow branches.

sentences.zh: 和風禁苑饒，陳仙樂，奏簫韶。

translations.literal: Harmonious winds abound in the imperial garden; immortal music is displayed, Xiaoshao is played.
translations.idiomatic: Harmonious winds abound in the imperial garden; immortal music is displayed and Xiaoshao is played.

sentences.zh: 三五正良宵，宮漏永，月輪高。

translations.literal: On the fifteenth, a proper fine night; the palace water clock runs long, the moon wheel is high.
translations.idiomatic: On the fifteenth, a fine night; the palace water clock runs long and the moon wheel rides high.

sentences.zh: 皇帝常朝二章康熙年定。

translations.literal: Two sections for the Emperor's regular court audience, established in the Kangxi reign.
translations.idiomatic: Two musical sections for the emperor's regular court audience were established in the Kangxi reign.

sentences.zh: 中和韶樂

translations.literal: Zhonghe Shaoyue
translations.idiomatic: Zhonghe Shaoyue, Harmonious Shaoyue Music

sentences.zh: 升座隆平赫矣天鑒，眷求惟聖。

translations.literal: Ascending the throne—Longping: Bright is Heaven's observation; it seeks and favors only the sage.
translations.idiomatic: Ascending the throne, Longping: Bright is Heaven's observation; it seeks and favors only the sage.

sentences.zh: 保佑我清，既集有命。

translations.literal: Protect and bless our Qing; the mandate has already been gathered.
translations.idiomatic: Protect and bless our Qing; the mandate has already been gathered.

sentences.zh: 假樂大君，天位以正。

translations.literal: How joyous is the great lord; the heavenly position is thereby rectified.
translations.idiomatic: How joyous is the great lord; the heavenly position is thereby rectified.

sentences.zh: 蒞下有容，監於萬方。

translations.literal: Descending with dignified bearing; overseeing the myriad regions.
translations.idiomatic: He descends with dignified bearing and oversees the myriad regions.

sentences.zh: 念茲崇功，駿命孔常。

translations.literal: Reflecting on these lofty achievements; the great mandate is greatly constant.
translations.idiomatic: Reflecting on these lofty achievements, the great mandate endures in constancy.

sentences.zh: 還宮顯平於昭四後，誕降世德。

translations.literal: Returning to the palace—Xianping: Bright are the four sovereigns; descending is the world's virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Returning to the palace, Xianping: Bright are the four sovereigns; the world's virtue descends.

sentences.zh: 亹亹我皇，克艱袞職。

translations.literal: Assiduous is our emperor; he overcomes difficulty in the imperial duties.
translations.idiomatic: Assiduous is our emperor; he overcomes difficulty in fulfilling the imperial duties.

sentences.zh: 治定功成，中和建極。

translations.literal: Governance is settled and achievements accomplished; through harmony the supreme standard is established.
translations.idiomatic: Governance is settled and achievements accomplished; through harmony the supreme standard is established.

sentences.zh: 龍飛在天，鳳儀於廷。

translations.literal: The dragon flies in Heaven; the phoenix displays its grace in the court.
translations.idiomatic: The dragon flies in Heaven; the phoenix displays its grace in the court.

sentences.zh: 式奏王夏，垂億萬齡。

translations.literal: Thus is played the Royal Summer; extending for ten thousand myriad years.
translations.idiomatic: Thus is played the Royal Summer, extending for ten thousand myriad years.

sentences.zh: 乾隆七年，重定皇帝常朝正月二章中和韶樂，太簇商立宮，倍無射變宮主調。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Qianlong, two sections for the Emperor's regular court audience in the first month were re-established for Zhonghe Shaoyue, with Taicu Shang mode as the establishment mode and doubled Wushe bian mode as the main mode.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 7, two sections for the emperor's regular court audience in the first month were re-established for Zhonghe Shaoyue, with Taicu Shang as the establishment mode and doubled Wushe bian mode as the primary mode.

sentences.zh: 升座隆平敷天協氣鮮新，又蒼龍正晨。

translations.literal: Ascending the throne—Longping: Heaven spreads harmonizing qi, fresh and new; again the azure dragon is at the morning hour.
translations.idiomatic: Ascending the throne, Longping: Heaven spreads harmonizing qi, fresh and new; again the azure dragon marks the morning hour.

sentences.zh: 萬國歡心仰紫宸，皇天錫嘏懿純。

translations.literal: The myriad states rejoice in heart, looking up to the Purple Forbidden Hall; Imperial Heaven bestows blessing, pure and fine.
translations.idiomatic: The myriad states rejoice in heart, looking up to the Purple Forbidden Hall; Imperial Heaven bestows pure and fine blessing.

sentences.zh: 陳充庭，華瑵金根。

translations.literal: Arrayed filling the court; ornate tassels and golden axles.
translations.idiomatic: They are arrayed filling the court with ornate tassels and golden axles.

sentences.zh: 扇春風，風兆人，澤如春。

translations.literal: Fanning the spring wind; the wind foretells the people; grace like spring.
translations.idiomatic: Fanning the spring wind; the wind foretells the people; grace falls like spring.

sentences.zh: 睿周萬品，化洽無垠。

translations.literal: Sagely encompassing the myriad things; transformation harmonizes without limit.
translations.idiomatic: Sagely encompassing the myriad things, transformation harmonizes without limit.

sentences.zh: 還宮顯平淵然至道游神，協天行地文。

translations.literal: Returning to the palace—Xianping: Profound is the supreme Way, the spirit roams; harmonizing Heaven's conduct and Earth's pattern.
translations.idiomatic: Returning to the palace, Xianping: Profound is the supreme Way as the spirit roams; Heaven's conduct and Earth's pattern are harmonized.

sentences.zh: 照騰華若早輪，清明廣大和誾。

translations.literal: Illumination rises splendid as the early wheel; clear and bright, vast and harmonious, gentle and kind.
translations.idiomatic: Illumination rises splendid as the early wheel; clear and bright, vast and harmonious, gentle and kind.

sentences.zh: 恩滂洋，葭葦霑仁。

translations.literal: Grace pours abundantly; reeds and rushes are moistened with benevolence.
translations.idiomatic: Grace pours abundantly; reeds and rushes are moistened with benevolence.

sentences.zh: 念民生，生此辰，酌於民。

translations.literal: Mindful of the people's livelihood; born in this hour, measuring for the people.
translations.idiomatic: Mindful of the people's livelihood; born in this hour, he measures all things for the people.

sentences.zh: 瑞惟大有，寶則賢臣。

translations.literal: Auspicious signs are only in great abundance; the treasure is the worthy ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Auspicious signs appear only in great abundance; the treasure is the worthy ministers.

sentences.zh: 二月二章中和韶樂，夾鍾清商立宮，倍應鍾變宮二調。

translations.literal: Two sections for the second month, Zhonghe Shaoyue, with Jiazhong qing Shang mode as the establishment mode and doubled Yingzhong bian mode as the two main modes.
translations.idiomatic: Two sections for the second month use Zhonghe Shaoyue, with Jiazhong qing Shang as the establishment mode and doubled Yingzhong bian mode as the two primary modes.

sentences.zh: 升座隆平所無逸，恭己岩廊，萬協嘉祥。

translations.literal: Ascending the throne—Longping: In the place of no idleness; reverently attending to affairs in the rock gallery; the myriad harmonize in auspicious signs.
translations.idiomatic: Ascending the throne, Longping: In the place of no idleness he reverently attends to affairs in the rock gallery; the myriad harmonize in auspicious signs.

sentences.zh: 吹律圜鍾諧舜琯，負扆當陽。

translations.literal: Blowing the pitch-pipe, the round bell harmonizes with Shun's tube; leaning on the screen facing the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Blowing the pitch-pipe, the round bell harmonizes with Shun's tube; he leans on the screen facing the sun.

sentences.zh: 柳風初轉芽黃，翠甸輕雷蘇百昌。

translations.literal: Willow wind first turns and buds turn yellow; on the green plain light thunder awakens the hundred prosperities.
translations.idiomatic: Willow wind first turns and buds turn yellow; on the green plain light thunder awakens the hundred prosperities.

sentences.zh: 發生心，皇奉若；

translations.literal: A heart of generating life; the Emperor follows accordingly;
translations.idiomatic: With a heart of generating life, the Emperor follows accordingly;

sentences.zh: 寬大詔，播天常。

translations.literal: broad and generous edicts, spreading Heaven's constants.
translations.idiomatic: broad and generous edicts spread Heaven's constants.

sentences.zh: 還宮顯平肅群後，鳴佩鏘鏘，拜手仰龍光。

translations.literal: Returning to the palace—Xianping: Solemn are the assembled lords; ringing pendants resound; bowing with joined hands, looking up to the dragon's radiance.
translations.idiomatic: Returning to the palace, Xianping: Solemn are the assembled lords; ringing pendants resound as they bow with joined hands and look up to the dragon's radiance.

sentences.zh: 初日曈曨奎壁麗，明庶風翔。

translations.literal: The first sun dim and hazy, Kui and Bi splendid; the bright multitude wind soars.
translations.idiomatic: The first sun rises dim and hazy; Kui and Bi are splendid and the bright multitude wind soars.

sentences.zh: 普天和氣休穰，浹化鷹成鳩眼良。

translations.literal: Throughout Heaven harmonious qi rests in abundance; permeating transformation, the hawk becomes the dove, eyes good.
translations.idiomatic: Throughout Heaven harmonious qi rests in abundance; permeating transformation, the hawk becomes the dove with gentle eyes.

sentences.zh: 躬清明，基宥密；

translations.literal: Personally clear and bright, foundation in deep care;
translations.idiomatic: Personally clear and bright, with foundation in deep care;

sentences.zh: 恩溥洽，達要荒。

translations.literal: grace broadly harmonizes, reaching the farthest wilds.
translations.idiomatic: grace broadly harmonizes, reaching the farthest wilds.

sentences.zh: 三月二章中和韶樂，姑洗角立宮，黃鍾宮主調。

translations.literal: Two sections for the third month, Zhonghe Shaoyue, with Guxian jue mode as the establishment mode and Huangzhong mode as the main mode.
translations.idiomatic: Two sections for the third month use Zhonghe Shaoyue, with Guxian jue as the establishment mode and Huangzhong mode as the primary mode.

sentences.zh: 升座隆平日麗風和遍寰區，新榆改火。

translations.literal: Ascending the throne—Longping: Sun beautiful and wind harmonious throughout the realm; new elm, changing fire.
translations.idiomatic: Ascending the throne, Longping: Sun beautiful and wind harmonious throughout the realm; new elm and changing fire.

sentences.zh: 龍旂荏苒晃鸞坡，赫如曦，皇升座。

translations.literal: Dragon banners gradually sway on the phoenix slope; brilliant as dawn, the Emperor ascends the throne.
translations.idiomatic: Dragon banners gradually sway on the phoenix slope; brilliant as dawn, the Emperor ascends the throne.

sentences.zh: 群辟奏瑤珂，拂花茵，垂佩多。

translations.literal: The assembled lords play jade pendants; brushing flower mats, many pendants hang down.
translations.idiomatic: The assembled lords play jade pendants; brushing flower mats, many pendants hang down.

sentences.zh: 天門蕩蕩無偏頗，純嘏詠卷阿。

translations.literal: Heaven's gate is vast without partiality; pure blessing is sung in Juan'a.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's gate is vast without partiality; pure blessing is sung in Juan'a.

sentences.zh: 還宮顯平瑞靄祥飆映彤墀，紅雲繚繞。

translations.literal: Returning to the palace—Xianping: Auspicious mist and propitious gale reflect on the vermilion steps; red clouds coil around.
translations.idiomatic: Returning to the palace, Xianping: Auspicious mist and propitious gale reflect on the vermilion steps; red clouds coil around.

sentences.zh: 一人淵默德光昭，百花中，千門曉。

translations.literal: The One Man deep and silent, virtue's light shining; among the hundred flowers, a thousand gates at dawn.
translations.idiomatic: The One Man is deep and silent, virtue's light shining; among the hundred flowers, a thousand gates greet the dawn.

sentences.zh: 銅鶴篆煙飄，奏仙音，駕退朝。

translations.literal: Bronze cranes, seal-script smoke drifting; playing immortal music, the carriage withdraws from court.
translations.idiomatic: Bronze cranes stand as seal-script smoke drifts; immortal music plays as the carriage withdraws from court.

sentences.zh: 促耕布穀飛靈沼，盈耳說農勞。

translations.literal: Urging plowing, the cuckoo flies over the spirit marsh; filling the ears, speaking of farming toil.
translations.idiomatic: Urging plowing, the cuckoo flies over the spirit marsh; the ears are filled with talk of farming toil.

sentences.zh: 四月二章中和韶樂，仲呂清角立宮，大呂清宮主調。

translations.literal: Two sections for the fourth month, Zhonghe Shaoyue, with Zhonglu qing jue mode as the establishment mode and Dalu qing mode as the main mode.
translations.idiomatic: Two sections for the fourth month use Zhonghe Shaoyue, with Zhonglu qing jue as the establishment mode and Dalu qing mode as the primary mode.

sentences.zh: 升座隆平玉宸旦婺中，天王御法宮。

translations.literal: Ascending the throne—Longping: At the jade hall's dawn, Wu in mid-heaven; the Heavenly King presides at the Dharma Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Ascending the throne, Longping: At the jade hall's dawn, Wu is in mid-heaven; the Heavenly King presides at the Dharma Palace.

sentences.zh: 乘硃路，曳長虹。

translations.literal: Riding the vermilion road, trailing the long rainbow.
translations.idiomatic: Riding the vermilion road, trailing the long rainbow.

sentences.zh: 六六泠簫諧女鳳，萬物被薰風。

translations.literal: Six-six cold flutes harmonize with the female phoenix; the myriad things receive the balmy wind.
translations.idiomatic: Six-six cold flutes harmonize with the female phoenix; the myriad things receive the balmy wind.

sentences.zh: 阜財解慍，福祿來同。

translations.literal: Wealth increases and resentment is dispelled; fortune and emolument come together.
translations.idiomatic: Wealth increases and resentment is dispelled; fortune and emolument come together.

sentences.zh: 還宮顯平麥秋滿野登，桑穠繭已成。

translations.literal: Returning to the palace—Xianping: Wheat in autumn fills the fields for harvest; mulberries are thick and cocoons are formed.
translations.idiomatic: Returning to the palace, Xianping: Wheat in autumn fills the fields for harvest; mulberries are thick and cocoons are formed.

sentences.zh: 玉衡正，泰階平。

translations.literal: The jade balance is correct; the Grand Steps are level.
translations.idiomatic: The jade balance is correct; the Grand Steps are level.

sentences.zh: 上下交孚寰海靖，婦子樂盈寧。

translations.literal: Above and below mutually trust; the realm and seas are tranquil; wives and children rejoice in full peace.
translations.idiomatic: Above and below mutually trust; the realm and seas are tranquil; wives and children rejoice in full peace.

sentences.zh: 罄天亙地，茂豫桐生。

translations.literal: Exhausting Heaven and spanning Earth; flourishing ease, the paulownia grows.
translations.idiomatic: Exhausting Heaven and spanning Earth; flourishing ease, the paulownia grows.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四十一年，平定兩金川，四月御殿二章中和韶樂，中呂清角立宮，大呂清宮主調。

translations.literal: In the forty-first year of Qianlong, upon the pacification of the Two Jinchuan, two sections for the fourth month audience at the imperial hall, Zhonghe Shaoyue, with Zhonglu qing jue mode as the establishment mode and Dalu qing mode as the main mode.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 41, upon the pacification of the Two Jinchuan, two sections for the fourth month audience at the imperial hall use Zhonghe Shaoyue, with Zhonglu qing jue as the establishment mode and Dalu qing mode as the primary mode.

sentences.zh: 升座隆平玉衡紀正陽，昇平景運昌。

translations.literal: Ascending the throne—Longping: The jade balance marks the proper yang; rising peace, the splendid fortune flourishes.
translations.idiomatic: Ascending the throne, Longping: The jade balance marks the proper yang; rising peace and splendid fortune flourish.

sentences.zh: 豐功著，威稜揚。

translations.literal: Abundant achievements are displayed; majestic power is raised.
translations.idiomatic: Abundant achievements are displayed; majestic power is raised.

sentences.zh: 險辟蠶叢歸指掌，決勝廟謨長。

translations.literal: Perilous paths of Cancon return to the palm; victory decided, the temple strategy endures long.
translations.idiomatic: Perilous paths of Cancon return to the palm; victory is decided and the temple strategy endures long.

sentences.zh: 凱聲競奏，喜起賡颺。

translations.literal: Triumph songs compete in performance; joy rises and continues in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Triumph songs compete in performance; joy rises and continues in succession.

sentences.zh: 還宮顯平功成愷澤滂，兵消喜氣揚。

translations.literal: Returning to the palace—Xianping: Achievements accomplished, harmonious grace pours abundantly; weapons stilled, joyous qi rises.
translations.idiomatic: Returning to the palace, Xianping: Achievements accomplished, harmonious grace pours abundantly; weapons are stilled and joyous qi rises.

sentences.zh: 櫜弓矢，掃欃槍。

translations.literal: Sheathing bows and arrows; sweeping away the comet.
translations.idiomatic: Sheathing bows and arrows; sweeping away the comet.

sentences.zh: 紫閣酬庸膺懋賞，虎拜沐恩光。

translations.literal: At the Purple Pavilion rewarding merit, receiving grand awards; tiger-like bowing, bathed in gracious light.
translations.idiomatic: At the Purple Pavilion merit is rewarded with grand awards; they bow like tigers, bathed in gracious light.

sentences.zh: 萬年受祜，慶衍無疆。

translations.literal: For ten thousand years receiving blessing; celebration extending without limit.
translations.idiomatic: For ten thousand years receiving blessing; celebration extends without limit.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四十一年，平定兩金川，御殿群臣慶賀一章丹陛大樂

translations.literal: In the forty-first year of Qianlong, upon the pacification of the Two Jinchuan, one section of celebration by the assembled ministers at the imperial hall audience—Danbi Dayue.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 41, upon the pacification of the Two Jinchuan, one celebration section by the assembled ministers at the imperial hall audience uses Danbi Dayue.

sentences.zh: 慶平遠播皇威鯨鯢掃，瘴雨蠻煙盡消。

translations.literal: Qingping: Far spreading the imperial majesty; whales and crocodiles swept away; miasmic rain and barbarian smoke all dispelled.
translations.idiomatic: Qingping: The imperial majesty spreads far; whales and crocodiles are swept away; miasmic rain and barbarian smoke are all dispelled.

sentences.zh: 看振旅，歡聲載道。

translations.literal: Behold the returning army; joyous voices fill the roads.
translations.idiomatic: Behold the returning army; joyous voices fill the roads.

sentences.zh: 瞻天處，樂奏簫韶。

translations.literal: Gazing toward Heaven's place; music plays Xiaoshao.
translations.idiomatic: Gazing toward Heaven's place, music plays Xiaoshao.

sentences.zh: 五月二章中和韶樂，蕤賓變徵立宮，太簇商主調。

translations.literal: Two sections for the fifth month, Zhonghe Shaoyue, with Ruibin bian zhi mode as the establishment mode and Taicu Shang mode as the main mode.
translations.idiomatic: Two sections for the fifth month use Zhonghe Shaoyue, with Ruibin bian zhi as the establishment mode and Taicu Shang mode as the primary mode.

sentences.zh: 升座隆平禁林清，反舌無聲。

translations.literal: Ascending the throne—Longping: The forbidden forest is clear; the mockingbird is silent.
translations.idiomatic: Ascending the throne, Longping: The forbidden forest is clear; the mockingbird is silent.

sentences.zh: 登進忠良佞不行，南風假大而宣平。

translations.literal: Promoting the loyal and worthy, the crafty do not advance; the southern wind is borrowed great and spreads peace.
translations.idiomatic: Promoting the loyal and worthy, the crafty do not advance; the southern wind is borrowed great and spreads peace.

sentences.zh: 坐明堂，賞五德，法乘離以持衡。

translations.literal: Sitting in the Bright Hall; appreciating the five virtues; taking Li as model to hold the balance.
translations.idiomatic: Sitting in the Bright Hall, he appreciates the five virtues and takes Li as model to hold the balance.

sentences.zh: 還宮顯平槿初榮，旉與硃明。

translations.literal: Returning to the palace—Xianping: Hibiscus first blooms; spreading with vermilion brightness.
translations.idiomatic: Returning to the palace, Xianping: Hibiscus first blooms, spreading with vermilion brightness.

sentences.zh: 天稷星邊漢影萌，紅輪照九神嘉生。

translations.literal: Beside the Heavenly Millet star, Han's shadow sprouts; the red wheel illuminates the nine spirits, auspicious life.
translations.idiomatic: Beside the Heavenly Millet star, Han's shadow sprouts; the red wheel illuminates the nine spirits and auspicious life.

translations.literal: Mindful of farming and tilling, summer heat and rain; the reverent imperial heart finds no rest.
translations.idiomatic: Mindful of farming and tilling, summer heat and rain; the reverent imperial heart finds no rest.

translations.literal: In the forty-first year of Qianlong, upon the pacification of the Two Jinchuan, two sections for the fifth month audience at the imperial hall, Zhonghe Shaoyue, with Ruibin bian zhi mode as the establishment mode and Taicu Shang mode as the main mode.

translations.literal: Ascending the throne—Longping: Fanning the balmy wind; the six curtains auspiciously harmonize.
translations.idiomatic: Ascending the throne, Longping: Fanning the balmy wind; the six curtains auspiciously harmonize.

sentences.zh: 共解征衣拜舞同，雲開玉壘昭膚功。

translations.literal: Together removing campaign garments, bowing and dancing alike; clouds part at Yulei, displaying the merit of pacification.
translations.idiomatic: Together removing campaign garments, they bow and dance alike; clouds part at Yulei, displaying the merit of pacification.

sentences.zh: 頌聲靈，赫以濯；

translations.literal: Praising the sound of spirit, brilliant in cleansing;
translations.idiomatic: Praising the sound of spirit, brilliant in cleansing;

translations.literal: joy in sheathing weapons; achievements inscribed on bells.
translations.idiomatic: joy in sheathing weapons; achievements inscribed on bells.

sentences.zh: 還宮顯平慶天中，凱奏勛隆。

translations.literal: Returning to the palace—Xianping: Celebrating mid-Heaven; triumph music plays, merit lofty.
translations.idiomatic: Returning to the palace, Xianping: Celebrating mid-Heaven; triumph music plays and merit is lofty.

sentences.zh: 笮徼煙消化雨濃，磨崖紀勒銘重重。

translations.literal: At Zha frontier passes smoke clears and rain is thick; cliff inscriptions record achievements, inscriptions layered.
translations.idiomatic: At Zha frontier passes smoke clears and rain is thick; cliff inscriptions record achievements in layers of inscriptions.

sentences.zh: 壯皇猷，沛帝澤；

translations.literal: Strengthening the imperial design; abundantly the Emperor's grace;
translations.idiomatic: Strengthening the imperial design; abundantly the Emperor's grace;

sentences.zh: 聽歡聲，遍堯封。

translations.literal: hearing joyous voices throughout Yao's domain.
translations.idiomatic: hearing joyous voices throughout Yao's domain.

sentences.zh: 六月二章中和韶樂，林鍾清變徵立宮，夾鍾清商主調。

translations.literal: Two sections for the sixth month, Zhonghe Shaoyue, with Linzhong qing bian zhi mode as the establishment mode and Jiazhong qing Shang mode as the main mode.
translations.idiomatic: Two sections for the sixth month use Zhonghe Shaoyue, with Linzhong qing bian zhi as the establishment mode and Jiazhong qing Shang mode as the primary mode.

sentences.zh: 升座隆平鼓含少，黃宮諧鳳，伏庚光，赤帝騎龍。

translations.literal: Ascending the throne—Longping: The drum contains shao; the yellow palace harmonizes with the phoenix; Fu Geng's light; the Red Emperor rides the dragon.
translations.idiomatic: Ascending the throne, Longping: The drum contains shao; the yellow palace harmonizes with the phoenix; Fu Geng's light; the Red Emperor rides the dragon.

sentences.zh: 暳彼三星正昏中，茂對乘時穆聖衷。

translations.literal: Dim are those three stars at dusk mid-heaven; abundantly responding, riding the season, reverent is the sage heart.
translations.idiomatic: Dim are those three stars at dusk mid-heaven; abundantly responding, riding the season, reverent is the sage heart.

sentences.zh: 陳金奏，宣景風，明光覲辟公。

translations.literal: Displaying golden performance; proclaiming the auspicious wind; bright light, the lords come to audience.
translations.idiomatic: Displaying golden performance; proclaiming the auspicious wind; in bright light the lords come to audience.

sentences.zh: 還宮顯平彌六合，黎元祝頌，奉三無，帝念淵沖。

translations.literal: Returning to the palace—Xianping: Filling the six directions; the common people bless and praise; offering the three without; the Emperor's thought is deep and humble.
translations.idiomatic: Returning to the palace, Xianping: Filling the six directions; the common people bless and praise; offering the three without; the Emperor's thought is deep and humble.

sentences.zh: 蓊鬱元雲渰宸楓，大雨時行黍稷芃。

translations.literal: Lush primal clouds darken the imperial maples; great rain timely falls, millet and glutinous millet luxuriant.
translations.idiomatic: Lush primal clouds darken the imperial maples; great rain falls in season and millet and glutinous millet grow luxuriant.

sentences.zh: 虞琴奏，皇在宮，勤思劇月農。

translations.literal: Yu-qin is played; the Emperor is in the palace, diligently thinking intensely of the month's farming.
translations.idiomatic: The Yu-qin is played; the Emperor is in the palace, diligently thinking of the month's farming.

sentences.zh: 七月二章中和韶樂，夷則徵立宮，姑洗角主調。

translations.literal: Two sections for the seventh month, Zhonghe Shaoyue, with Yize zhi mode as the establishment mode and Guxian jue mode as the main mode.
translations.idiomatic: Two sections for the seventh month use Zhonghe Shaoyue, with Yize zhi as the establishment mode and Guxian jue mode as the primary mode.

sentences.zh: 升座隆平金井桐飄大火流，夷則聲清律應秋。

translations.literal: Ascending the throne—Longping: Golden well paulownia drifts, the Great Fire flows; Yize's sound is clear, pitch-pipes respond to autumn.
translations.idiomatic: Ascending the throne, Longping: Golden well paulownia drifts as the Great Fire flows; Yize's sound is clear and the pitch-pipes respond to autumn.

sentences.zh: 天行轉蓐收，黃茂滿田疇。

translations.literal: Heaven's course turns to Rusou; yellow abundance fills the fields.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's course turns to Rusou; yellow abundance fills the fields.

sentences.zh: 曉光閶闔浮，搏拊戛鳴球。

translations.literal: Dawn light floats at the Heavenly Gate; clapping hands strike the sounding orb.
translations.idiomatic: Dawn light floats at the Heavenly Gate; clapping hands strike the sounding orb.

sentences.zh: 玉殿千官咸拜手，仰宸斿。

translations.literal: In the jade hall a thousand officials all bow with joined hands, looking up to the imperial banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the jade hall a thousand officials all bow with joined hands, looking up to the imperial banner.

sentences.zh: 還宮顯平鷹祭蟬鳴屆白藏，御廩初登穀始嘗。

translations.literal: Returning to the palace—Xianping: Eagle sacrifice, cicadas cry, white storehouse arrives; the imperial granary first registers grain, grain first tasted.
translations.idiomatic: Returning to the palace, Xianping: The eagle sacrifice comes, cicadas cry, white storehouse arrives; the imperial granary first registers grain and grain is first tasted.

sentences.zh: 秋回禁陛涼，皇居奠總章。

translations.literal: Autumn returns, the forbidden steps are cool; the imperial residence is established at Zongzhang.
translations.idiomatic: Autumn returns and the forbidden steps are cool; the imperial residence is established at Zongzhang.

sentences.zh: 恩膏正溥將，零露浥瀼瀼。

translations.literal: Gracious balm is just broadly spreading; light dew is moist and abundant.
translations.idiomatic: Gracious balm is just broadly spreading; light dew is moist and abundant.

sentences.zh: 六合熙熙齊所卬，潔珠囊。

translations.literal: The six directions all harmoniously together look up; pure pearl bags.
translations.idiomatic: The six directions all harmoniously look up together; pure pearl bags are offered.

sentences.zh: 八月二章中和韶樂，南呂清徵立宮，仲呂清角主調。

translations.literal: Two sections for the eighth month, Zhonghe Shaoyue, with Nanlu qing zhi mode as the establishment mode and Zhonglu qing jue mode as the main mode.

sentences.zh: 升座隆平乾坤爽氣澄序，宮殿清光靜安。

translations.literal: Ascending the throne—Longping: Heaven and Earth fresh qi clear the sequence; palace halls clear light, tranquil and peaceful.
translations.idiomatic: Ascending the throne, Longping: Heaven and Earth's fresh qi clear the sequence; palace halls shine with clear light, tranquil and peaceful.

sentences.zh: 設九賓而法見，葉九和於天端。

translations.literal: Setting the nine guests and the law appears; leaves of nine harmonies at Heaven's summit.
translations.idiomatic: Setting the nine guests, the law appears; leaves of nine harmonies reach Heaven's summit.

sentences.zh: 晻靄揚雲鶒，玲瓏動玉鑾。

translations.literal: Dim mist raises the cloud pheasant; exquisite and delicate, the jade chariot bells move.
translations.idiomatic: Dim mist raises the cloud pheasant; exquisite and delicate, the jade chariot bells move.

sentences.zh: 烈徽猷兮萬世，肅纓冕兮千官。

translations.literal: Bright imperial design for ten thousand generations; solemn caps and crowns for a thousand officials.
translations.idiomatic: Bright imperial design for ten thousand generations; solemn caps and crowns for a thousand officials.

sentences.zh: 還宮顯平雲高漢迥參見，露白飆清洌寒。

translations.literal: Returning to the palace—Xianping: Clouds high, the Milky Way distant, Shen appears; dew white, wind clear and cold.
translations.idiomatic: Returning to the palace, Xianping: Clouds ride high, the Milky Way distant, Shen appears; dew is white, wind clear and cold.

sentences.zh: 汔告成夫萬寶，祗祝釐於三壇。

translations.literal: Nearly announcing completion of the myriad treasures; reverently offering blessings at the three altars.
translations.idiomatic: Nearly announcing completion of the myriad treasures; blessings are reverently offered at the three altars.

sentences.zh: 瑞穀歧而秀，玉粢好且完。

translations.literal: Auspicious grain branches and is splendid; jade grain is good and complete.
translations.idiomatic: Auspicious grain branches and is splendid; jade grain is good and complete.

sentences.zh: 喜盈寧兮百室，國安泰兮民歡。

translations.literal: Joy fills peace in a hundred households; the state is secure and tranquil, the people rejoice.
translations.idiomatic: Joy fills peace in a hundred households; the state is secure and tranquil and the people rejoice.

sentences.zh: 九月二章中和韶樂，無射羽立宮，蕤賓變徵主調。

translations.literal: Two sections for the ninth month, Zhonghe Shaoyue, with Wushe yu mode as the establishment mode and Ruibin bian zhi mode as the main mode.
translations.idiomatic: Two sections for the ninth month use Zhonghe Shaoyue, with Wushe yu as the establishment mode and Ruibin bian zhi mode as the primary mode.

translations.idiomatic: Ascending the throne, Longping: The wild goose rests on the silver islet; chrysanthemums have yellow flowers.

translations.idiomatic: A fine day meets the fine ordinance; yellow banners array at the proper court.

translations.idiomatic: Leopard poles move; dragon scales shoot; the sun rises on vermilion clouds; Heaven bestows our emperor abundant crops.

translations.idiomatic: Rippling golden wind; fragrant garments for the carriage; Heaven's sandals speak of returning leisure.

translations.idiomatic: Yellow clouds fragrant fill the carts; in every village by day the flail sounds.

translations.idiomatic: Glorious is the sage sun; the spirit screen shines with color; warmth reaches all in ranks.

translations.idiomatic: Timely issuing edicts and commands; the bright and worthy rejoice and rise; what is treasured is only the worthy.

translations.idiomatic: Ascending the throne, Longping: On the seventh day yang comes; Heaven and Earth are benevolent; the myriad forms all divide from one center.

translations.idiomatic: From the heart people raise statecraft; the ordinances of the three talents belong to the great lord.

translations.idiomatic: Responding to yang at the jade hall; without partiality learning the transforming balance; encompassing the primal and treading virtue with daily laborious diligence.

sentences.zh: 品類盛，荷陶甄。

translations.literal: All categories flourish; receiving molding and nurture.
translations.idiomatic: All categories flourish, receiving molding and nurture.

translations.idiomatic: Returning to the palace, Xianping: Following qi, auspicious wind soars across the nine bounds; the Grand Astrologer correctly inscribes the clouds.

translations.idiomatic: Deep deliberation precedes things, blessing the living; deep and silent like thunder, he holds the Way's truth.

translations.idiomatic: Eight winds follow the sequence evenly; Heaven's root and Moon's cave follow; bright as the sun rectifying the three luminaries.

translations.idiomatic: Not far to return; thereby cultivating the person.

translations.idiomatic: Our emperor wears the great fur robe; at the Dharma seat the kings and marquises attend.

translations.idiomatic: Serving old virtue and spreading new designs; solemn as Heaven's rites, fortune and emolument are strong.

translations.idiomatic: Returning to the palace, Xianping: Great Chamber yellow clouds, purple qi veiled; timely snow reports a year of abundance.

translations.literal: Heaven's gate bellows filled; year-end drums urge spring, Heaven and Earth connected.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's gate bellows are filled; year-end drums urge spring and Heaven and Earth are connected.

translations.literal: The imperial house's precious thread flourishes; accord moves, shining and harmonizing.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial house's precious thread flourishes; accord moves, shining and harmonizing.

translations.literal: Moon in the west crescent; sun born in the east; ten thousand years circling without cease, the same.
translations.idiomatic: Moon in the west crescent; sun born in the east; ten thousand years circling without cease, ever the same.

sentences.zh: 耰耡既畢恩澤滂，自天集福多豐穰。

translations.literal: Hoeing and plowing already complete, grace spreading abundantly; from Heaven gathering blessing, much abundance and plenty.
translations.idiomatic: Hoeing and plowing already complete, grace spreading abundantly; from Heaven gathering blessing, much abundance and plenty.

sentences.zh: 來牟蕎蘥森紫芒，華薌赤甲秈稈䄱。

translations.literal: Coming wheat, buckwheat, dense purple awns; fragrant millet, red husk, indica stalks full.
translations.idiomatic: Coming wheat, buckwheat, dense purple awns; fragrant millet, red husk, indica stalks full.

sentences.zh: 秬秠三種黎白黃，稷粟堅好碩且香。

translations.literal: Black millet, white millet, three kinds, black, white, yellow; millet grain firm and good, large and fragrant.
translations.idiomatic: Black millet, white millet, three kinds, black, white, yellow; millet grain firm and good, large and fragrant.

sentences.zh: 萃芑大穗盈尺長，五菽五豆充壠場。

translations.literal: Gathering qi, great ears filling a foot long; five beans, five pulses filling the ridge-fields.
translations.idiomatic: Gathering qi, great ears filling a foot long; five beans, five pulses filling the ridge-fields.

sentences.zh: 穄粢縻九色糧，蜀秫玉黍兼東廧。

translations.literal: Ji, zi, nine-colored grain; Shu sorghum, jade millet together with eastern wall millet.
translations.idiomatic: Ji, zi, nine-colored grain; Shu sorghum, jade millet together with eastern wall millet.

sentences.zh: 烏未同收除童粱，雙歧合穎遍理疆。

translations.literal: Crow and pheasant together harvested, removing tong liang; double ears, united tips pervading the governed borders.
translations.idiomatic: Crow and pheasant together harvested, removing tong liang; double ears, united tips pervading the governed borders.

sentences.zh: 千箱萬斛收神倉，四時順序百穀昌。

translations.literal: Thousand boxes, myriad measures collected in the divine granary; four seasons in order, hundred grains flourishing.
translations.idiomatic: Thousand boxes, myriad measures collected in the divine granary; four seasons in order, hundred grains flourishing.

sentences.zh: 八區九有富蓋藏，歡騰億兆感聖皇。

translations.literal: Eight regions, nine possessions rich in storage; joy soaring, billions upon billions feeling the sage Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Eight regions, nine possessions rich in storage; joy soaring, billions upon billions feeling the sage Emperor.

sentences.zh: 皇后採桑歌一章乾隆七年定。

translations.literal: Empress's mulberry-picking song, one section, established in the seventh year of Qianlong.
translations.idiomatic: Empress's mulberry-picking song, one section, established in Qianlong 7.

sentences.zh: 躬耕禮成詔井桑，蠶月吉巳迎辰祥。

translations.literal: Personally plowing rite complete, edict announcing well and mulberry; silkworm month, auspicious si, welcoming chen auspice.
translations.idiomatic: Personally plowing rite complete, edict announcing well and mulberry; silkworm month, auspicious si, welcoming chen auspice.

sentences.zh: 金華紫罽五翟光，瑞雲彩映椒塗黃。

translations.literal: Golden splendor, purple brocade, five pheasants' radiance; auspicious clouds' colors reflecting pepper path yellow.
translations.idiomatic: Golden splendor, purple brocade, five pheasants' radiance; auspicious clouds' colors reflecting pepper path yellow.

sentences.zh: 壇南宿戒惟宮張，西陵展事搖珩璜。

translations.literal: Altar south, overnight vigil only palace spread; Western Mound displaying the rite, shaking huang and huang.
translations.idiomatic: Altar south, overnight vigil only palace spread; Western Mound displaying the rite, shaking huang and huang.

sentences.zh: 齋肅恭敬柔雍彰，金鉤綠籧懿筥筐。

translations.literal: Fast pure, reverent and respectful, soft and harmonious displayed; golden hook, green basket, fine beautiful basket.
translations.idiomatic: Fast pure, reverent and respectful, soft and harmonious displayed; golden hook, green basket, fine beautiful basket.

sentences.zh: 尚功尚制奉以將，柔條在東涵露香。

translations.literal: Chief of Works, Chief of Manufacture bearing and leading; soft branches in the east, containing dew fragrance.
translations.idiomatic: Chief of Works, Chief of Manufacture bearing and leading; soft branches in the east, containing dew fragrance.

sentences.zh: 鞠衣三摘鳴鳩翔，月靈臨賁龍精昌。

translations.literal: Silkworm robes, three pickings, cuckoo flying; moon spirit approaching brilliance, dragon essence flourishing.
translations.idiomatic: Silkworm robes, three pickings, cuckoo flying; moon spirit approaching brilliance, dragon essence flourishing.

sentences.zh: 黼黻五色質且良，昭事上帝祠烝嘗。

translations.literal: Embroidered robes, five colors, quality and good; displaying affairs, serving God, offering steam and tasting.
translations.idiomatic: Embroidered robes, five colors, quality and good; displaying affairs, serving God, offering steam and tasting.

sentences.zh: 儀型宇宙帥妃嬙，衣食滋殖被萬方。

translations.literal: Model for the cosmos leading consorts and ladies; clothing and food nourishing and spreading to the myriad regions.
translations.idiomatic: Model for the cosmos leading consorts and ladies; clothing and food nourishing and spreading to the myriad regions.
